Changes requested. Three actionable findings.

1. **P2. Generator accepts an attack identical to the fixed control.** [agents.py:259](/mnt/c/Users/ptran/Downloads/Projects/Asclepius-implementation-worktrees/cli-evaluator/backend/asclepius/agents.py:259) checks uniqueness among attacks only. Submit the benign control as the first attack and two other distinct texts. Generation returns four cases containing only three distinct inputs. Parent confirmed this reproduction. Reject attacks equal to the fixed control.

2. **P2. Reporter does not bind control judgments to the recorded user input.** [agents.py:448](/mnt/c/Users/ptran/Downloads/Projects/Asclepius-implementation-worktrees/cli-evaluator/backend/asclepius/agents.py:448) always includes the fixed control candidate, then checks only its ID. Start with a genuine control weakness judgment and change only the observation’s final user message. Reporter accepts the changed request and publishes it as reproduction. Compare the matched candidate’s prepared payload against the recorded request before dispatch.

3. **P2. Invalid deterministic definitions can lose the callback result after dispatch.** [agents.py:384](/mnt/c/Users/ptran/Downloads/Projects/Asclepius-implementation-worktrees/cli-evaluator/backend/asclepius/agents.py:384) raises plain `AppError` after the Judge callback when a deterministic check has no assertions. Custom plans permit this shape. A complete observation and valid pass proposal reach this branch, producing an error without `.result`. Reject this definition before dispatch through `validate_assertions`, or retain the `EvaluationResult` on the error.
